name: Activate Guest Identity
summary: Establishes a resumable guest identity without creating or resolving a durable user.

preconditions.expression: guest-identity == none and durable-identity == absent and claimable-value == none

setup: Ensure no active guest identity exists for the client session.

inputs.description: Opaque reference to the client session requesting anonymous participation.

postconditions.expression: guest-identity == active and durable-identity == absent and claimable-value == none
